items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts (ticking exhaust leak)
items.job: Extract broken manifold bolts and replace manifold gasket (one side)
items.note: The low end is a simple gasket and bolt job; extracting snapped bolts or replacing a warped manifold adds time and cost.

items.t: Speedometer and gauges stick or stop working
items.job: Remove instrument cluster, send out for rebuild, reinstall
items.note: One owner was quoted about $600 at a dealer. A new cluster costs more and must be programmed to the truck.

items.t: Wipers turn on by themselves or stop working
items.job: Replace windshield wiper motor and module assembly
items.note: If your truck falls under the wiper recall, the dealer repair is free.

items.t: Windshield wiper motor can fail (recall)
items.job: Recall: inspect wiper motor, install module cover or replace motor

items.t: Air blows from the wrong vents or will not cool
items.job: Replace HVAC mode/blend door actuator
items.note: Owners reported total costs of about $150 to $200 or more depending on the shop.

items.t: Blower motor wiring or resistor overheats
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor and connector pigtail
items.note: If the wiring harness itself is melted, more labor is needed.

items.t: Rusted brake lines burst (pedal sinks to the floor)
items.job: Replace rusted brake lines and bleed the system
items.note: Replacing every line front to rear takes longer than repairing one section.

items.t: Hydro-boost brake accumulator can crack (recall)
items.job: Recall: test hydro-boost unit and replace if it fails

items.t: Hydro-boost relief valve seal may fracture (recall)
items.job: Recall: replace hydro-boost relief valve

items.t: Heated washer fluid system fire risk (recall)
items.job: Recall: install fused harness or disable heated washer module

items.t: Front ball joint or steering knuckle failure
items.job: Replace front lower ball joints or control arms (both sides)
items.note: A 2009 H2 lower control arm estimate ran about $720 to $1,270 per side at shops. A damaged knuckle or hub adds parts.

items.t: Loose, wandering steering (worn pitman and idler arms)
items.job: Replace pitman arm and idler arm, align front end
items.note: One owner paid about C$1,200 including a reinforcement kit.

items.t: Power steering leaks and hard steering
items.job: Replace leaking power steering hose or cooler line
items.note: RepairPal lists H2 power steering hose replacement at about $440 to $520. A new pump costs more.

items.t: No-start from theft system or ignition switch
items.job: Replace ignition switch or lock cylinder and relearn theft system
items.note: RepairPal lists H2 ignition switch replacement at about $200 to $300.

items.t: Airbag light on (airbag module or water damage)
items.job: Diagnose airbag system and replace airbag control module
items.note: Some owners report the original module is hard to get; a rebuilt unit can be cheaper.

items.t: Sunroof drains clog and leak water inside
items.job: Clear and test sunroof drain tubes
items.note: If a drain tube has come off its fitting, the headliner may need to come down.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or stuck in gear
items.job: Rebuild or replace 4-speed automatic transmission
items.note: One owner reported about C$6,400 for front differential and transmission work together.

items.t: Six-speed automatic shifts harshly or loses drive
items.job: Diagnose and rebuild/replace 6-speed automatic
items.note: Smaller faults may be fixed with a valve body or sensor instead of a full rebuild.

items.t: Front differential seal and transmission cooler line leaks
items.job: Replace front differential seal or transmission cooler line

items.t: Power window falls into door or stops working
items.job: Replace window motor and regulator assembly
items.note: YourMechanic quotes about $490 for a rear H2 window motor/regulator; RepairPal lists about $740 to $790.

items.t: Paint peeling on rear quarter panels
items.job: Refinish rear quarter panel
items.note: An owner reported paying about $400.

items.t: Heated seats turn on by themselves or overheat
items.job: Replace seat heater element or control module

items.t: Front wheel bearing hub failure
items.job: Replace front wheel bearing hub assembly (one side)
items.note: YourMechanic quotes about $820 for one front H2 wheel bearing.

items.t: ABS and traction control lights come on
items.job: Diagnose ABS codes; replace wheel speed sensor or ABS module
items.note: A wheel speed sensor is cheap; an ABS module costs much more.

items.t: Frame and subframe rust
items.job: Repair rusted subframe support or frame section
items.note: One dealer estimated $1,500 to $2,000 for a subframe repair.

items.t: Fuel pump flow control module failure
items.job: Replace fuel pump flow control module

items.t: Low oil pressure or failing lifters
items.job: Replace lifters and related valvetrain parts (or engine)
items.note: One owner reported about $7,000 when the engine needed major work.

items.t: Radiator leaks coolant
items.job: Replace radiator

items.t: Crankshaft sensor wiring breaks down
items.job: Replace crankshaft position sensor and repair wiring pigtail
items.note: One owner paid about $80.

items.t: Stumbles and stalls right after a cold start
items.job: Diagnose drivability problem (scan, throttle body cleaning, software)
items.note: Cost depends on what the diagnosis finds.
